summary: Attack the frozen compatibility gate with a valid additive pair whose two adapters act on the same output direction. Do not change thresholds. If the gate rejects a composition that exactly improves the mixed task, the component-projection criterion is invalid and must be removed/redefined before any LLM-scale H3 experiment.
falsifier: If additive composition has strong mixed-task gain but frozen gate rejects it because composed output no longer equals each component target in isolation, reject the component-projection gate design.
